image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot looking through the center of a car wheel. The foreground is dominated by the inner structure of the wheel rim and tire sidewall, which frame a background scene of a marina or boatyard with several boats, trailers, and a blue sky with clouds. The wheel appears to be an alloy rim with a black tire.

artifact_observations.reasoning: There is red text on the tire sidewall that reads something like 'Nanon' or similar nonsensical string. Real tires have molded alphanumeric codes (DOT, size, brand). This looks like AI-generated gibberish text attempting to mimic branding.

The inner edges of the rim where it meets the background scene show slight blending and softness. The structural thickness of the rim varies inconsistently, appearing to melt slightly into the background boats in the lower-left quadrant.
The background boats exhibit slight warping and inconsistent perspective lines, common in AI images where the background is generated to fit a foreground mask. The horizon line seems slightly curved.
